{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to only completed orders (exclude refunded)
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed_data))

# Check revenue column: it's string with commas
print("Sample of revenue values (before cleaning):")
print(completed_data['revenue'].head())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_data['revenue_clean'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the conversion worked
print("Sample of cleaned revenue:")
print(completed_data['revenue_clean'].head())"}
